_comment: What every audit must cover, read by /new-audit and /new-page-audit. `subagents` is what claude-seo should run, listed so the commands can check it actually did; a missing one goes in `method` and `notCovered`, never silently. `supplements` are this repo's own additions for gaps in claude-seo. Each says why it exists and when to delete it. When claude-seo is upgraded past `claudeSeoVersion`, re-check every `gap` and delete supplements claude-seo now covers itself.

site._comment: claude-seo's seo-audit spawns these itself. Do not spawn them again; only check they ran.

when.seo-local: local business detected (brick-and-mortar, service-area or hybrid)
when.seo-matomo: Matomo credentials configured. claude-seo 2.5.0 names this agent but ships no agents/seo-matomo.md, so expect it to fail and list it in notCovered
when.seo-cluster: blog, pillar pages or topic clusters detected
when.seo-maps: local business detected and DataForSEO MCP available
when.seo-drift: a drift baseline exists for the URL

page._comment: claude-seo's seo-page runs no subagents, so /new-page-audit spawns these itself, each scoped to the one URL. Site-wide subagents (seo-sitemap, seo-backlinks, seo-cluster, seo-maps) are left out on purpose.

when.seo-local: local business detected (brick-and-mortar, service-area or hybrid)
when.seo-ecommerce: the page is a product, category or cart page
when.seo-drift: a drift baseline exists for the URL

supplements.when: the site serves more than one language or region
supplements.gap: seo-audit never delegates to seo-hreflang, and seo-page only checks that hreflang tags exist.
supplements.removeWhen: seo-audit spawns seo-hreflang and seo-page validates reciprocity and x-default.

target.site: the homepage plus up to 4 distinct page templates (for example a product, category, article and contact page)

supplements.gap: seo-audit has no image subagent. seo-technical, seo-performance and seo-visual each touch images, but none checks file sizes, formats, alt text and lazy loading together.

seo-audit has no social-tag check, and seo-page lists the tags on one page without checking that the share image loads. Requires Open Graph and twitter:card only: X falls back to og:* for title, description and image.
supplements.removeWhen: seo-audit checks Open Graph tags and share images on every page.

supplements.when: always, with or without Google API credentials
supplements.gap: seo-performance runs PageSpeed Insights at its own discretion and reports prose, and seo-page never measures it. The report's Core Web Vitals panel needs the same keyless JSON from every audit.
supplements.removeWhen: claude-seo's audits always run pagespeed_check.py and keep its JSON output.

supplements.run: "$CLAUDE_SEO" run fetch_page.py <url> --json, then classify its headers and HTML by claude-seo's skills/seo-technical/references/stack-cve-exposure.md (in the plugin install, two levels above "$CLAUDE_SEO")
supplements.gap: claude-seo 2.5.0 added the server stack CVE check to the seo-technical skill only. Audits spawn the seo-technical agent, whose Security category is still HTTPS and headers, so the check does not run.
supplements.removeWhen: agents/seo-technical.md runs the stack CVE check.
